name: European Securities and Markets Authority — news feed (BLOCKED)

rate_limit.source: Not polled. Recorded only so the source shows as blocked with its reason.

failure_behavior: The poller never fetches a blocked source; the terminal lists it as blocked with the reason.
verdict_reason: On 2026-10-23 www.esma.europa.eu answered HTTP 403 Forbidden to a declared-User-Agent client for the home page, the news page and /rss.xml, and also to a second fetcher for the legal notice, so neither a feed URL nor the reuse terms could be read. The block is not circumvented. Next step: the owner reads the legal notice in a browser and asks ESMA for an automated-access route.

datasets.description: ESMA news and press releases (not ingested)
